info.about: The Saboteur is an action-adventure game developed by Pandemic Studios and published by Electronic Arts. It was released for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360 in December 2009.
info.trivia: The PS3 version was noted for its anti-aliasing, on a console that had traditionally struggled with it.
info.why: It was the final game Pandemic Studios developed before the studio closed in 2009.
